note: Art direction for Hui Hai (HH1), chosen by the owner on 2026-09-27: the Hàng Trống folk painting 'White Tiger' (Bạch hổ), Hanoi, traditional design (public domain, https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:White_tiger_Hang_Trong.jpg). The owner's bar: a real hand-made painting in the tiger's own bright, saturated gouache-and-watercolour look, never cute game art. The Hui Hai are drawn as tiny spirit folk in leaf clothes, never as a picture of the Ba Na people. After drawing, run python tools/bleed_colour.py on each new picture: it makes the colour spill past the ink lines, a little off register, like the hand-coloured original.
style:
A painting in EXACTLY the look of the reference image, the Vietnamese Hàng Trống folk painting of the White Tiger: the same luminous, vibrant colours and the same brightness, opaque gouache and watercolour on paper, soft and chalky, bright but not neon. A flat, mid cerulean-cobalt ground, a little mottled with uneven brushing. Swirling cloud scrolls in hot pink, emerald green, orange and lemon yellow with white edges along the top, and a red sun. Big bold simple shapes, few elements, the figure large in the picture.
COLOUR ON THE FIGURES, exactly as on the tiger: the figures and the big leaves are MOSTLY CREAM-WHITE, pale and light, like the tiger's white body, which covers much of the picture. On that cream, the painter dabbed a FEW small splotches of strong colour in unexpected places, the way the tiger has green eyes, a lilac-grey crown, a red tongue and a small green-and-red disc: a small splotch or two of green, a red one, a touch of lilac-grey or yellow, and green eyes. These accents are SMALL, maybe a tenth of the figure; the rest stays cream-white. Leaf clothes and fern fronds are cream-white leaves with thin olive vein strokes and only a few green splotches, NOT painted green all over. Pink and vermilion edging appears only on some edges. Rocks are rough orange-ochre shapes blotched with dark brown, no 3D shading.
THE HAND OF THE PAINTER: Hàng Trống pictures were printed as black woodblock outlines and coloured by hand, fast, by village painters, so colour and line never quite line up: colour patches are offset from their outlines and spill over them, the blue was brushed roughly around the figures, colours bleed into each other with soft wet edges, pigment pools and blots, and brush strokes turn up in unexpected places. Outlines are coarse and uneven, thick and thin, sometimes broken. Few strokes: fur, hair and leaf veins are a handful of loose dashes, not fine hatching. Faces are five or six brush marks (two eyes, brows, a dot of a nose, a red mouth, two cheek dabs), no shading; an old face gets two or three wrinkle dashes. Slightly soft focus, like an old photograph of the painting. Never crisp, never neat, never delicate.
Do not draw a tiger or a cat and do not copy the reference's composition. The Hui Hai are tiny forest spirits of Vietnam's Central Highlands, drawn close up so the figure fills much of the picture, with fern leaves and pebbles shown huge beside them to tell their small size; they wear clothes of woven leaves; never a picture of any real people or their dress. They are NOT European elves, gnomes or dwarves: small rounded human ears, never pointed ears, no pointed hats or hoods, no long wizard beards. A real hand-made painting, not digital illustration, not a cartoon, not anime, no big eyes, no glossy or 3D rendering. Absolutely no text, letters, Chinese characters, seals, stamps or watermarks.
BRIGHTNESS AND BALANCE: keep the whole picture as light and bright as the reference: large cream-white areas, the cobalt ground, the bright clouds, and only small splotches of green, red and other colours.

families.Hui Hai: Background: the cobalt ground and many-coloured cloud scrolls of the reference, a red sun, one or two huge cream-white fern fronds with thin olive veins and a few green splotches, a stem of bamboo and a few rough ochre pebbles.

heroFamilies.Hui Hai: Background: the cobalt ground and many-coloured cloud scrolls of the reference, a red sun, one or two huge cream-white fern fronds with thin olive veins and a few green splotches, a stem of bamboo and a few rough ochre pebbles.

subjects.HH1-H01-kitten: the littlest Hui Hai: a tiny girl spirit in a dress of cream-white woven leaves with a few green splotches and a small red sash, her cream-white hair with a lilac-grey streak, in a tuft tied with a yellow grass blade and a small orange flower, pushing with both arms a rough ochre boulder many times her size, beside one huge cream-white fern frond. Her face is an old Vietnamese folk-painting face: round and flat, two small almond eyes with GREEN irises, arched thin brows, a tiny red mouth, pink cheek dabs; a calm, simple expression.
subjects.HH1-H01-bigcat: the littlest Hui Hai: a tiny girl spirit in a dress of cream-white woven leaves with a few green splotches and a small red sash, cream-white hair with a lilac-grey streak tied with a yellow grass blade, standing proudly on top of a rough ochre boulder in a stream, holding a pebble high over her head in one hand, the stream drawn as bands of white and turquoise wave lines, one huge cream-white fern frond bowing over her. Her face is an old Vietnamese folk-painting face: round and flat, two small almond eyes with GREEN irises, arched thin brows, a tiny red mouth, pink cheek dabs; a calm, simple expression.
subjects.HH1-D01: a Hui Hai of the stream: a tiny boy spirit in a cape of cream-white fern leaves with a few green splotches and a small turquoise tie, spiky cream-white hair with lilac-grey tips, green eyes, crouched on a rough ochre rock in a stream drawn as bands of white and turquoise wave lines, flicking a splash of water at a small red-and-orange fish.
subjects.HH1-D02: Yă Hui Hai, Lady of the Ferns: a tiny OLD woman spirit, clearly a grandmother, white hair in a bun with a red berry pin, green eyes, a calm, dignified, slightly stern face, wrapped in a cream-white shawl woven of dry moss with a few small green and yellow splotches, sitting in the coil of one huge cream-white unfurling fern frond, one hand resting on a big rough ochre rock.
subjects.HH1-D03: no full figure: a single pebble landing with a little white splash of dust beside a big muddy human footprint and a dropped woven bamboo carrying basket tipped on its side on rough light ochre ground, as if someone just ran off; at the side one huge fern frond cream-white with thin olive veins and a few green splotches, and in a gap between its leaflets two tiny round green eyes of an unseen little spirit, clearly eyes in a shadowy gap of the leaves, not birds. No sandals, no shoes.
subjects.HH1-D04: a Hui Hai in the ferns: only the head and shoulders of a tiny spirit girl with cream-white hair and green eyes peeking out between the leaflets of one huge cream-white fern frond with a few green splotches; the fern bends as if something just moved it.
subjects.HH1-D05: a pebble-thrower: a tiny spirit boy with a cream-white leaf tunic, a small red sash and a lilac-grey tuft of hair, winding up to throw a smooth pebble with all his might, one leg raised, standing on a rough ochre rock among cream-white ferns.
subjects.HH1-D06: a Hui Hai at the spring: a tiny spirit girl in a cream-white leaf dress with a few green splotches, sitting cross-legged beside a small round forest spring drawn as rings of white and turquoise lines, arms crossed, guarding it, a red leaf in her hair.
subjects.HH1-D07: a boulder-pusher: a tiny, stocky spirit man in a cream-white leaf loincloth-skirt and cape with a small red sash, leaning his shoulder into a rough ochre boulder far bigger than a house compared with him, rolling it along a path at night under the red moon among cream-white ferns.
subjects.HH1-D08: a Hui Hai in the bamboo: a tiny spirit boy in cream-white leaves with green eyes, running up a tall stem of bamboo like a squirrel, knocking on it with a small stick, lilac-grey hair streaming behind him.
subjects.HH1-D09: a keeper of the old forest: a tiny, serious spirit man, bare-headed with short cream-white hair tied in a small knot, a short cream-white beard, green eyes, in a cream-white bark-cloth wrap with a few green splotches and a small red sash, standing guard with a long fern stalk like a staff at the foot of a huge old tree trunk with twisting cream roots.
subjects.HH1-D10: Gơhlŏu, the sweet-smelling thing that lives in the trees and that nobody has seen: no clear figure, only a soft round cream-white glow nestled high in the branches of a big tree, with drifting cream and pink scent swirls like little clouds coming from it, a few small yellow and red blossoms around it.
subjects.HH1-D11: Moss-Mender Yă Hui Hai: a tiny old spirit woman with white hair in a bun and green eyes, frowning with concentration, pressing a pad of green moss onto a scraped knee of a small cream-white Hui Hai child sitting on a rough ochre rock; a little basket of green moss beside her.
subjects.HH1-D12: the Old One of the Waterfall: an ancient tiny spirit man with a long cream-white beard that flows down into a tall waterfall drawn as bands of white and turquoise lines, sitting calmly on a rough ochre ledge in the middle of it with his eyes closed, a red berry in his beard.
subjects.HH1-D13: no figure: dozens of small round pebbles flying through the air in arcs from behind the cream-white ferns on both sides of a forest path, drawn with little white motion lines, and not one hand to be seen.
subjects.HH1-D14: no figure: the forest remembers: a huge old tree with a cream-white trunk and twisting roots, and in the bark two large calm green eyes, open, watching, one old axe mark on the trunk; cream-white ferns and ochre rocks at its foot.
subjects.HH1-D15: no figure: an empty forest path winding between cream-white ferns and bamboo, a single pebble still rolling to a stop on it, and a small puff of white dust where it landed.
subjects.HH1-D16: an object, no figure: a small pouch woven of cream-white grass tied with a red cord, lying open on a rough ochre rock, spilling a handful of flat, irregular river stones of different shapes and sizes, grey, slate, lilac and ochre, clearly stones and not eggs.
subjects.HH1-D17: Grandfather Hui Hai, Mover of Rocks: a tiny, broad-shouldered old spirit man with a small cream-white beard, green eyes and a red headband, holding a big rough ochre rock high over his head with both arms, easily, standing among cream-white ferns.
subjects.HH1-D18: the Hidden Village: a forest clearing seen from above the ferns, full of dozens of tiny cream-white Hui Hai spirits half-hidden everywhere, among roots, under leaves, on rocks and in the bamboo, each with a small splash of colour, a red sash, a green leaf, a lilac tuft, all peeking out.
subjects.HH1-D19: no figure: a huge rough ochre rock with dark brown blotches sitting on top of a green hill at night under a red moon, with a long trail of flattened cream-white grass behind it showing that it moved uphill by itself, and far below, tiny footprints.
subjects.HH1-D20: small but strong: a tiny spirit girl in a cream-white leaf dress with a small red sash and green eyes, giving an enormous two-handed shove to a big rough ochre rock that tips over, her cheeks puffed out with effort, cream-white ferns around.
